title: Integral closure respects torsion-free group gradings
statement: Let $A=\bigoplus_{g\in G}A_g$ be a domain graded by a torsion-free abelian group $G$, and let $R=\bigoplus_{g\in G}R_g\subseteq A$ be a graded subring. If $x\in A$ is integral over $R$, then every homogeneous component of $x$ is integral over $R$. We use the monoid and group-completion conventions of [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup].
